name: Polymarket Calibration Benchmark, 2026 Q4 (OVERROUND)
description: Market-level calibration and Brier scores for Polymarket, computed from public on-chain data over a fixed twelve-month window (markets resolved 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30, excluding voided, disputed, and short-duration Up/Down markets). Four CSV tables: horizon decay over a constant 30,973-market universe, per-horizon full universes, calibration curves by price decile at 24 hours and 30 days, and accuracy by category at 24 hours for every category with at least 2,000 markets. Three republishable chart PNGs render the same tables. Methodology, limitations, robustness cuts, and the age of the price behind the short-horizon rows: https://www.overround.pro/benchmarks/polymarket-calibration-2026-q4 Produced by OVERROUND (overround.pro), an independent analytics project on publicly available prediction-market data. Immutable edition; a new quarter publishes a new edition. Editions are named for the quarter they are published in.
